note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent auditor, after the user-namespace conversion): every tagged unit now opens with `if !userns.Enter(t) { return }`, which re-executes the test in its own user, network and mount namespace and carries the child's fail or skip to the parent (Enter, internal/test/userns/userns_linux.go), and the file builds under plain linux instead of integration && linux. RFC 5798 Section 7.2 says "Set the source MAC address to virtual router MAC Address" TestTxAdvertV4OnWire (v2 and v3) and TestTxAdvertV6OnWire capture the transmitted frame on the peer veth and compare its source MAC with the literals 00-00-5e-00-01-0a and 00-00-5e-00-02-0a, never the package constants. Single-polarity. Verdict enforced.
